primaryWitnesses.text: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

wikipediaRead.title: Abel-meholah
wikipediaRead.readExcerpt: Abel-meholah was an ancient city frequently mentioned in the Hebrew Bible. The site of Abel-meholah has not yet been identified with certainty. Modern scholars generally agree that it has to be found in that area and west of the Jordan River; Tell Abu Sifri and Tell Abu Sus are candidates.
wikipediaRead.paraphraseJa: 冒頭は聖書上の町名とし、所在地節は正確な遺跡を未確定として複数候補を挙げる。1 Kings 4:12の地区境界についても聖書言及節で明記。

notesJa: 本文初出4:12では行政区画の境界。19:16は後続の別用例で、エリシャの出身地情報はfact gateに分離。
